title: Traces
subtitle: Spans your app sends over OpenTelemetry, stored on this node for the logs retention window.

setup.title: Send traces from this app
setup.off: Tracing is off. Turn it on to get an ingest key and the environment variables for your OpenTelemetry SDK.
setup.on: Tracing is on. Point your SDK's OTLP/HTTP exporter at this control plane.
setup.keyOnce: This key is shown once. Set these on the app and redeploy. Rotating makes the old key stop working.
setup.protocolNote: Use OTLP over HTTP, protobuf or JSON. gRPC is not accepted here.
setup.disabledToast: Tracing is off. The app's exporter will get 401 responses.

list.empty: No traces in this window yet. Send a request through the app, or widen the window.
list.emptyOff: Tracing is off for this app, so nothing is collected. Turn it on to get an ingest key.
